name: @lunelson/pi-vscode
description: Attach a live Pi session to VS Code: editor selection as a cache-friendly prompt section, plus diagnostics and open-editor tools, via a companion VS Code extension.
author: Rahul Arya

scripts.build: esbuild extension/src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=extension/dist/extension.js --external:vscode --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate && cd extension && vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../dist/pi-vscode-bridge.vsix
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
